Name: BobbingDisabler
Author: heartolazor
Description:
HeartoLazor's utilitary mod for disabling the 'bobbing' effect that stardew engine introduces in movement animations.
Useful for Fashion Sense's mods that uses custom body animations with baked displacements in the sprites.

Source code available at: [url=https://github.com/HeartoLazor/StardewValleyBobbingDisabler]https://github.com/HeartoLazor/StardewValleyBobbingDisabler[/url]
